stories.title: OKC's Williams (ankle), Wallace (shoulder) to undergo surgery
stories.summary: Thunder guards Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace will both be sidelined indefinitely after undergoing ankle and shoulder surgery, respectively.

stories.title: 'No controversy': Cousins to remain Raiders' starting QB, Kubiak says
stories.summary: Kirk Cousins will remain the Raiders' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Jets, coach Klint Kubiak announced Monday.

stories.title: Ex-Cowboy Bryant calls out police investigation after he's cited for assault
stories.summary: Dez Bryant is calling for a thorough investigation by Texas' Southlake Police Department of an incident that resulted in him receiving a citation for assault.

stories.title: RG3 '100 percent' interested in Baylor coaching job, has talked with AD
stories.summary: Robert Griffin III, Baylor's only Heisman Trophy winner, said Monday that he is interested in being the Bears' new football coach.

stories.title: Kane beats Mbappé, Yamal to win Ballon d'Or, England's 1st in 25 years
stories.summary: Harry Kane has become the first Englishman to win the Ballon d'Or in 25 years after beating Kylian Mbappé and Lamine Yamal to the award in London on Saturday.
